title: Production Python Project Structure for AI Agents
why: A toy script is just one file. A production AI agent has configuration, tool directories, memory providers, prompt templates, API routers, and test suites. Organizing files correctly prevents circular imports and makes your codebase ready for deployment.
objectives: Structure an enterprise-grade AI agent repository
concept: Standard architecture separates the Agent Runner (orchestration) from Tools (execution plugins), Memory (state stores), and Prompts (templates).

project.description: Level 1 Capstone: Autonomous CLI Research Agent Prototype
requirements: Combine Pydantic schemas, tool registry, mock LLM decision loop, and exception handlers
Implement persistent logging and sliding memory window
Provide complete README with setup and test instructions

checklist: Eliminated circular dependencies with clean package design
mistakes: Dumping all agent logic, prompts, and database calls into a single unmaintainable file
